claims.text: The Neural Image Captioning (NIC) model is used for evaluation in image captioning tasks.
The NIC model utilizes a CNN architecture, specifically VGG-16, for image feature extraction and LSTM for generating captions.
Evaluation metrics used include BLEU, ROUGE, and CIDEr, with CIDEr being specifically designed for image captioning.
